title: Gonality and quintic points on intermediate modular curves
summary: For $\{\pm 1\}\subseteq\Delta\subseteq(\mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z})^\times$ let $X_\Delta(N)$ be the intermediate modular curve between $X_1(N)$ and $X_0(N)$. We determine the $\mathbb{Q}$-gonality of every strict intermediate curve $X_\Delta(N)$ with $N\le 50$, and of $X_1(N)$ for $41\le N\le 50$, where it equals the upper bound of Derickx and van Hoeij at every level.
